title: Add generated transform definition registry
summary: Create a reusable generated-algebra transform definition registry that records transform type, source/target object roles, preservation policy, correspondence expectations, and law refs before individual families consume it.

sourceRefs.summary: Generated family ids and templates that should map to transform definitions.
Existing SemanticTransformation validation coverage to extend.

expectedLearning: What minimal data shape lets generated fixture families share SemanticTransformation definitions.
Which preservation and correspondence fields are common across generated algebra families.
allowedWork: Add a small typed registry or definition module.
Keep fixture templates separate from semantic transform definitions.
Add focused tests for registry completeness and lookup behavior.
disallowedWork: Do not migrate every generated fixture in this slice.
Do not add visual motif behavior here.
